name: rein
description: Interrogate an answer in an isolated side chat, then land the confirmed items so later turns stay aligned.

interface.shortDescription: Keep the agent aligned with what you confirmed
interface.longDescription: Ask about an answer without derailing the main thread. Confirmed assertions go into ALIGNMENT.md and are re-read by a hook on every prompt, so later turns carry them without you repeating yourself; one-off notes can be carried back to the main thread exactly once instead.
defaultPrompt: Open the alignment ledger panel for the last answer
